description:
Kanya Vivah Sahayta Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Uttar Pradesh in India. 

The scheme was launched on 1st April 2008. 

It aims to provide financial assistance for the marriage of girls belonging to economically weaker sections of society. 

The primary objective is to reduce the financial burden on families when it comes to marrying off their daughters. 

The scheme also aims to promote the education of girls and discourage child marriages. 

Under this scheme, a financial assistance of ₹51,000 is provided for the marriage of each girl. 

This amount is intended to help cover the expenses associated with the wedding ceremony. 

The scheme is particularly focused on girls from Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Other Backward Classes. 

However, it is also available to girls from economically weaker sections of the general category. 

To be eligible for the Kanya Vivah Sahayta Yojana, the girl must be at least 18 years old at the time of marriage. 

The family income should not exceed ₹2 lakh per annum. 

This income limit is set to ensure that the benefits reach the truly needy families. 

The applicant must also provide proof of her age and income. 

Educational qualifications are not a strict requirement for eligibility. 

However, preference is given to girls who have completed their education. 

The application process for the Kanya Vivah Sahayta Yojana is straightforward. 

Eligible applicants must fill out the application form available at the local government offices or online. 

The application form requires details such as the girl's name, age, family income, and marital status. 

Applicants must also submit supporting documents. 

These documents include a copy of the girl's birth certificate or school leaving certificate for age proof. 

A certificate of income from a competent authority is also required. 

Additionally, applicants must provide a marriage invitation card as proof of the marriage. 

Once the application is submitted, it is verified by the concerned authorities. 

The verification process typically takes about 15 to 30 days. 

After successful verification, the financial assistance is disbursed. 

The amount is usually transferred directly to the bank account of the beneficiary. 

This ensures transparency and reduces the chances of misuse of funds. 

The disbursement of funds is done in a timely manner to coincide with the marriage date. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Women and Child Development in Uttar Pradesh. 

This department is responsible for overseeing the application process and fund disbursement. 

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the department's helpline. 

The helpline number is available on the official website of the Uttar Pradesh government. 

The Kanya Vivah Sahayta Yojana has seen significant uptake since its inception. 

As of 2023, over 1.5 million girls have benefited from the scheme. 

The total amount disbursed under this scheme has crossed ₹7,650 crore. 

This demonstrates the government's commitment to supporting the marriage of girls from underprivileged backgrounds. 

The scheme has also contributed to a decline in child marriages in the state. 

Awareness campaigns are regularly conducted to inform families about the benefits of the scheme. 

These campaigns emphasize the importance of education and the legal age of marriage. 

The Kanya Vivah Sahayta Yojana is part of a broader initiative by the government to empower women. 

It aligns with the national goals of improving gender equality and women's rights. 

The scheme has been well-received by the public and has garnered positive feedback. 

Many families have expressed gratitude for the financial assistance provided. 

The scheme has also encouraged families to invest in the education of their daughters. 

By alleviating the financial burden of marriage, families are more likely to prioritize education. 

The government continues to monitor and evaluate the scheme's impact. 

Regular assessments are conducted to ensure that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries. 

The Kanya Vivah Sahayta Yojana is an essential step towards social upliftment. 

It plays a crucial role in changing societal attitudes towards the marriage of girls. 

Overall, the scheme is a significant initiative aimed at promoting the welfare of women in Uttar Pradesh. 

It reflects the government's commitment to ensuring that every girl has the opportunity for a dignified marriage. 

The Kanya Vivah Sahayta Yojana is a vital component of the state's welfare policies. 

It serves as a model for similar initiatives in other states across India. 

The scheme’s success can be attributed to its clear objectives and effective implementation. 

The financial assistance provided has made a tangible difference in the lives of many families. 

The scheme continues to evolve based on feedback and changing societal needs. 

In conclusion, the Kanya Vivah Sahayta Yojana is a comprehensive welfare scheme. 

It addresses the critical issue of financial support for the marriage of girls. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's efforts in promoting gender equality and women's empowerment. 

It stands as a beacon of hope for many families striving for a better future for their daughters.
